name: supreme-coding-guidelines
description: The .ah skill bundle for Claude Code. Combines token compression, surgical coding behavior, disciplined diagnosis, TDD, architectural control, and full-project audit discipline through the Teleological Semantic Format (.ah) created by David C. Cavalcante (originator of MAIC™, HIM™, and NHE™). Auto-discovers three skills from the skills/ directory: ah-parser (one-time bootstrap of the .ah grammar with three-mode output protocol), supreme-coding-guidelines (always-on behavioral rules), and supreme-project-audit (on-demand evidence-driven audit for Product/AI/ML/LLM engineers, LLM architects, and AI researchers). User code is always preserved verbatim regardless of output mode.
